q: After assembly dissolution and central rule in the state, rumour spreads that FIR registration and bail rights are suspended. Your desk is flooded with queries.
options: Stop registering cases till new ministry takes oath
Continue FIR, arrest safeguards and court production as rights continue unchanged
Suspend bail and hand all accused to central forces
Close station except emergency duties
expl: Central rule changes ministry, not citizen rights or procedure.
why: State emergency transfers executive to centre but does not suspend fundamental rights or procedure. On desk duty the SI must register and produce as before.
trapnote: Trap: ministry change mistaken for rights suspension.

q: During a proclaimed national emergency the DSP orders you to block all court access for detenus and ignore habeas petitions.
options: Obey fully and deny all access to courts
Continue protection against illegal detention and allow access to remedy, 20-21 safeguards survive
Torture to get confession as emergency permits
Stop producing arrest memos
expl: Even in emergency, life and fair-procedure protection cannot be suspended.
why: Emergency allows suspension of some rights but core protection of life and liberty remains enforceable. On custody duty the SI must maintain records and honour court orders.
trapnote: Trap: emergency equals total rights blackout.

q: On poll bandobast after central rule, party workers demand you evict rivals from the village to teach them a lesson, citing Governor powers.
options: Evict rivals using emergency powers without written order
Act neutrally on specific offences only, no political eviction without lawful order
Hand village control to ruling party agent
Impose curfew on opposition houses only
expl: Governor rule does not authorise partisan policing.
why: Failure of machinery changes who governs, not rule of law for police. On bandobast the SI must stay impartial and record illegal pressures.
trapnote: Trap: Governor rule misused for partisan action.

q: Rumour says financial emergency will cut police salaries and you may collect station fees to compensate. Constables ask your order.
options: Authorise informal collection till pay stabilises
Reject rumour, forbid illegal collection and continue lawful duties
Stop patrolling to save costs
Seize trucks to raise funds
why: Financial emergency only enables centre-state financial directions, not suspension of law. On station duty the SI must refuse illegal levy and report rumour.
trapnote: Trap: fiscal crisis excuse for extortion.

q: After emergency proclamation leaders claim preventive detention needs no grounds and courts cannot ask. You hold two youths for sloganeering.
options: Hold indefinitely without telling grounds
Communicate grounds promptly, allow representation and produce for review
Shift them to distant lockup to avoid review
File false recovery to justify hold
expl: Detention still needs grounds, representation and review.
why: Preventive detention safeguards survive emergency curbs and require fairness. On detention duty the SI must serve grounds and forward representation without delay.
